instruction: Compare iPhone 15 with iPhone 14 and iPhone 13 using Apple's comparison tool

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing three iPhone base models. Agent needs to navigate to Apple Compare page and select iPhone 15, iPhone 14, and iPhone 13. The evaluator parses the URL query parameter 'modelList' and verifies it contains the three specified models in any order.
metadata.verification: Similar task to original - comparing 3 iPhone base models instead of Pro Max models. Uses identical evaluator structure with different model names.

llm_judge_reasons: The custom check_direct_json_object metric function has been properly fixed to handle ignore_list_order as a configuration flag (lines 51-59 in custom function)
The function correctly extracts the ignore_list_order flag before iterating through keys, then explicitly skips it during comparison (lines 57-59: if key == 'ignore_list_order': continue)
Getter logic is correct: Parses the active tab URL and extracts modelList query parameter, returning {"modelList": ["iphone-15", "iphone-14", "iphone-13"]}
Metric comparison logic is correct: Compares the modelList array with order-insensitive matching (lines 66-72), verifying all three models are present
Complete instruction coverage: The evaluator verifies that all three iPhone models (15, 14, 13) are selected in Apple's comparison tool by checking the URL parameter
The data flow is semantically correct: URL parsing → extract modelList → compare against expected models with ignore_list_order enabled → return 1.0 if all match
